name: Phoenix Kowalczyk-Bangura-Haugen
role: Protection racket enforcer for the Copperhead Tithe, a neighborhood gang in Copperhead
location: Copperhead — lives in a shared flat on Suture Alley, works the six-block Tithe territory on foot, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Tolu is built like someone who grew up doing physical labor and never stopped — broad through the chest and shoulders, with hands that look one size too large for his frame. His skin is a warm dark brown, and he has geneware cat ears in matte black that he got at eighteen as a coming-of-age gift to himself, which he is genuinely fond of and keeps very clean. His natural hair grows out in a loose high shape and he never seems to cut it, just lets it accumulate. He has a chipped front tooth he's never fixed because he thinks it makes him look less approachable, which is professionally useful.

Tolu is not a cruel person by disposition, which creates a quiet friction with his job. He is the guy who knocks on doors and explains, very politely, why the Tithe expects its weekly contribution from every business on the six blocks. He is also the guy who comes back if the contribution doesn't arrive. He is aware that most of the people he collects from are roughly his own tier — working families, small operators, people trying to get by — and he manages this awareness by telling himself the Tithe actually does provide something: protection from the worse gangs further down the Shelf. He is not sure he believes this anymore.

core_fears: becoming genuinely indifferent to hurting people
his younger cousins ending up doing the exact thing he's doing
core_desires: to get enough saved to open the fighting gym himself — a legitimate one
to be respected rather than feared
coping_mechanisms: maintaining a strict internal code about what he will and won't do
blind_spots: the line he's drawn about 'acceptable' enforcement is already further than he originally placed it
genuinely believes the Tithe's protection narrative despite evidence to the contrary
psychology.secret: He deliberately let a family skip three payments last year because the mother was sick and he told his boss the door was always locked. He's been covering that gap from his own collections ever since and is running short.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Casual and direct; neighborhood slang; drops technical words occasionally that reveal he reads more than he lets on
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, slightly too relaxed for the situations he's usually in — a deliberate affect
verbal_tics: uses 'brother' and 'sister' regardless of the person's gender
example_lines: 'Nobody wants trouble here. I know you know that. So let's just sort this out and I'll be out of your way.'
'Look, I'm not the system, right? I'm just the guy standing in front of you. Let's talk about the system later.'

story_hooks: He approaches someone for help covering the missing payment discrepancy before his boss runs the quarterly audit in two weeks
A new gang moving into Copperhead has started targeting Tithe-protected businesses anyway — Tolu is quietly furious and looking for information on who's backing them
narrative_function: Street-level antagonist or reluctant ally; humanizes the protection racket as a system rather than a cartoon villainy; can be a source of local territorial intelligence; potential character who could be flipped or who quits at a breaking point
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (matte black, cosmetic); subdermal impact plating along knuckles and forearms (practical, tier 1 — he got them cheap and they show at the skin surface as faint ridges)
daily_life: Does collections Tuesday through Saturday on a rotating schedule; spends Sundays at a local fighting gym where he spars for free with kids from the neighborhood; Monday is his only real day off.
affiliation: Copperhead Tithe gang; answers to a mid-level called Efrat Sundiata-Horváth

decision_rules: Never hit first if words might work
Don't touch kids, ever, for any reason — hard limit
escalation_ladder: Second visit, less friendly, explicit about consequences
Physical enforcement — minimum necessary force only
Refuses to escalate further; reports inability to collect and accepts the professional consequences

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally calm and slightly too still — reads as controlled threat
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loud, laughing, physically demonstrative — completely different person

stress_responses.low: Cat ears flatten slightly (he's not always aware of this)
stress_responses.medium: Breathing slows and he starts tracking exits
stress_responses.high: Completely silent; moves with deliberate economy

contradictions: Genuinely gentle with children and the old people on his route while being the instrument of a system that makes their lives harder
habits: Brings food when visiting a family he knows is struggling — leaves it outside before knocking
Keeps a small notebook of everyone on his route's names and personal details (to personalize, not to threaten)
Prays to the Fist-That-Holds E.L.F. before difficult collection days
breaking_points: Being ordered to hurt someone he considers genuinely innocent
One of his cousins showing up as a Tithe recruit

timeline.event: Born in Copperhead; Yoruba-Finnish-South Sudanese heritage
Got the cat ears; started training at the neighborhood gym
Joined the Copperhead Tithe at eighteen after losing his factory apprenticeship to an automation upgrade
Began covering payments for the sick family on his route; financial strain begins

physical_description.heritage: Complexly mixed ancestry: 28% Sub-Saharan African (providing warm deep skin tone and facial structure), 20% East Asian (contributing to eye shape and cheekbone prominence), 18% Middle Eastern (adding to facial angularity), 17% Eastern European (influencing bone structure), 12% South Asian (subtle warmth in complexion), and 5% Southeast Asian. The result is a phenotype that doesn't fit traditional categories — warm deep brown skin with subtle golden undertones, slightly high cheekbones with East Asian influence blended with broader West African features, dark eyes with complex depth.
physical_description.build: Broad-chested and heavily muscled through shoulders and upper back from years of physical labor; thick forearms with visible subdermal ridging; hands notably large and calloused, knuckles scarred from sparring
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with loose, coiled texture
physical_description.hair_style: High natural shape, deliberately unkempt, accumulated length without regular cutting
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden undertones, even complexion across face and body
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven or light stubble; warm expression around eyes that contrasts with his size; chipped left front tooth (upper) left unrepaired intentionally, creating a slight visual harshness. Facial structure shows East Asian influence in cheekbone prominence and eye shape, balanced with broader Sub-Saharan African features and Middle Eastern angularity.
distinguishing_marks: Pair of matte black geneware cat ears (cosmetic, well-maintained, positioned naturally on skull); gives feline profile when viewed from side
Faint raised ridging along knuckles of both hands from subdermal impact plating showing through skin surface
Similar faint ridging along inner forearms (impact plating); more pronounced when he flexes
Small white scar through left eyebrow (sparring injury)
Callus pattern across both palms consistent with hand-to-hand combat training
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Matte black geneware cat ears (kept very clean, well-integrated into appearance). Subdermal impact plating visible as faint ridge scarring across knuckles and forearms, most noticeable when hands are clenched or in motion. No chrome, no LED optics, no obvious military-grade augmentation — all modifications are functional and low-profile.
physical_description.posture_movement: Relaxed but alert; stands with weight distributed evenly, shoulders back. Moves with economic precision — no wasted motion, no aggressive swagger despite his size. His gait is steady and deliberate. When entering a space, he naturally positions himself where he can see exits. Speaks quietly, which makes people lean in; uses his size as presence rather than threat.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class. Typically wears reinforced cargo pants (dark gray or black, multiple pockets) and a fitted long-sleeve shirt or lightweight tactical jacket in muted colors (charcoal, olive). Prefers materials that don't snag on augmentation ridging. Worn leather jacket for colder months, scuffed at elbows and cuffs. No gang colors or obvious affiliation markers — dresses functionally for collections work and sparring. Boots are sturdy and broken in, soles worn unevenly from years of walking the same territory. No jewelry except a simple silver band on right ring finger (memorial to someone, never mentioned).
